REPORT
S. 1, Special Branch Station,
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. 5592
No. D
Date 1 / 2 / 34
Date February 8, 1934.

Subject (in full) Relations between Soviet Authorities and
Tu Yueh-sung

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan

Despite careful and discreet enquiries no information
has been received to indicate that relations of a conspiratory
nature exists between Tu Yueh Sung and the Soviet Authorities.
Tu Yueh Sung is a director of the Ling Kee Co. which concluded
an agreement in October 1932 with the Dalles (Far Eastern
Lumber Trust of the U.S.S.R.) for the sale of timber exported
from Soviet Russia. The appeal of W.A. Morrison in his case
against Centrosojus Ltd. is still pending.
S.2, Special Branch assisted in the enquiry.

W Duncan.
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

FILE

SECRET CONFIDENTIAL

（左侧竖排文字）：SECRET CONFIDENTIAL

SPECIAL BRANCH
C.I.D. H.C.P.
No. D 5552
Date 11 / 12 / 33

Special Branch,
December 11, 1933.

S.1
Please endeavour to ascertain by very discreet
inquiries if any relations of a conspiratory nature
exist between Tu Yueh Sung and the Soviet Authorities.
It is reported that Tu Yueh Sung recently used his
influence to secure a verdict in the Morrison case
which would be satisfactory to Soviet Russia and that he has
rendered very effective assistance to the lumber trade of
that country through the Ling Kee Co., Canton Road.
If it is not possible to ascertain information in
a discreet way, it is best that the inquiry be dropped.
S.2 may be able to help.

J.W. Jones
Officer i/c Sp.Br.

TU Yueh Sung
Director of the Ling Kee Co. which concluded an
agreement in October 1932 with the Dalles (Far
Eastern Lumber Trust of the USSR) for sale of
timber exported from Soviet Russia.
Reportedly used his influence in V. A. MORRISON case
against Centrosojus Ltd.

SMP
